As soon as things settle down I'll share some interesting infographics on what Voat looks like from a technological viewpoint.

Here's a roundup of what I've been up to (all the functionality relies on the new API so consider this a sneak peek, not release notes. Screenshots are here.

 

What I've been doing: - Navigation now works from the sliding menu (see screenshots). You can select one of the defaults, choose from a list of favorites, or manually enter a subverse.

  • Login (this now works using the beta API).

  • Markdown support

  • Displaying read-only comments

  • Misc bug fixes/enhancements too small to detail

Coming Weeks - Voting on comments/submissions

  • Replying to comments

  • Displaying website links within the app

  • Relaxing and playing some Civ V

 

Important - opinions required

I made the conscious decision not to release features like login/commenting/voting until the new API is released. This will probably happen in a couple of weeks/months. Are you still ok with waiting that long, or should I investigate using legacy/unofficial APIs like other apps?
